scope: Read-only compiled production-engine footprint audit; no editor APIs, Worker, actor actions, layout edits or draft writes.
method: Actual production InstancedMesh geometry vertices transformed by instanceMatrix * matrixWorld. Root contacts and full projected-radius contacts tested against exact rendered path/water triangle footprints. Radius contacts are conservative plant-bound overlaps; projectedVertex identifies direct geometry penetration. Paired flower stems/blossoms deduplicated by root. Shrubs include bushes and pond-rest-shrub only, excluding ivy/tree canopy. Bird-border flowers are actual authored noninstanced stems/petals grouped by flower before production batching. Bank Reeds/Iris/Daisy use their actual merged GLB vertices and are checked against paving/bridge floors only, because shoreline plants may overhang water. Bridge triangles are the actual Continuous paved crossing meshes. Wind envelope adds the maximum grass (.42) / shrub (.17) shader displacement at maximum authored rain wind 1.02, transformed by the actual instance matrix. Bank shader wind uses .025*x/.018*z*localY at gardenBreeze1. Path core is a triangle whose three vertex R colors are >= .619; lower R blends opaque soil/moss into paving.
